name: Gastric (stomach) cancer
theme: the perioperative backbone · the biomarker quartet

meta.title: Gastric cancer in silico decision trainer
meta.population: Adults with gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma - one spec, with the SIEWERT BOUNDARY drawn honestly rather than cleanly: the evidence base itself enrolls gastric + GEJ together (FLOT4, MATTERHORN, CheckMate 649, SPOTLIGHT/GLOW, KEYNOTE-811 all did), Siewert I belongs to the queued esophageal row's paradigms (CROSS trimodality, CheckMate 577), Siewert III is gastric, and Siewert II is the genuinely contested zone - stated as contested. Diffuse/signet-ring histology carries its own honesty (chemo-resistant, peritoneum-tropic, CT-occult, CLDN18.2-enriched); hereditary CDH1 disease gets its counseling line (endoscopy misses it; risk-reducing gastrectomy is the conversation). The metastatic first line is THE BIOMARKER QUARTET - HER2, PD-L1 CPS, CLDN18.2, MSI - four tests that must ALL result before the menu is honest, and the trainer gates on exactly that.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the disease where the surrogate got audited and the biomarkers multiplied. Localized: D2 gastrectomy plus perioperative FLOT (FLOT4, verified: median OS 50 vs 35 months - the backbone that ranks) with the IO add-on carried at its exact currency: MATTERHORN's durvalumab won EVENT-FREE survival decisively (EFS HR 0.71; pCR 19.2% vs 7.2%) and was FDA-approved 2025-11-25 ON THAT ENDPOINT while its interim OS (HR 0.78) was NOT significant - the card displays EFS-labeled with the currency named; and KEYNOTE-585 renders beside it as THE SURROGATE'S AUDIT: pem…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: AJCC TNM; the Lauren diffuse/intestinal split as biology note; Siewert classification at the GEJ (I esophageal / III gastric / II contested - said so); universal HER2 + PD-L1 CPS + CLDN18.2 + MSI testing in advanced disease (the quartet); NCCN Gastric v3.2026 (secondhand - 403)
meta.response: RECIST 1.1; the perioperative era's contested surrogate is pathologic complete response - and KEYNOTE-585 is this spec's standing lesson that pCR gains do not automatically cash into event-free survival

Newly diagnosed.name: Perioperative FLOT + D2 gastrectomy (FLOT4 - the ranked backbone)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the perioperative standard (NCCN secondhand); FLOT4 the receipt
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: a four-drug regimen around a major operation - cytopenias and neuropathy on the chemo side, the permanent eating change on the surgical side
Newly diagnosed.patient: The curable-disease standard: strong chemotherapy before and after an operation that removes part or all of the stomach - the combination that lifted median survival from about three years to over four.

Newly diagnosed.name: Adding durvalumab to FLOT (MATTERHORN - approved ON event-free survival)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: FDA-approved 2025-11-25 ON EFS (secondhand) - the currency is named on the card
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized - EFS decisive, interim OS NS (EFS-labeled: displays, never ranks); the 585 audit carried
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: FLOT's ledger plus the immune one, through the perioperative window and beyond
Newly diagnosed.patient: The newest addition to the curable-disease standard: immunotherapy woven through the chemotherapy-and-surgery plan - approved on proof that it keeps cancer events away longer, with the longer-life question still maturing, and the card says exactly that.

Newly diagnosed.name: Pembrolizumab + trastuzumab + chemo (KEYNOTE-811 - the HER2 door)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the HER2+ 1L standard (CPS>=1 concentration noted; label scope confirm)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized - OS met (verified); approved 2026-08-25 (NEJM PMID 42202319)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: chemo + trastuzumab's cardiac watch + the immune ledger
Newly diagnosed.patient: For HER2-positive spread disease: three medicines together - chemotherapy, the HER2 antibody, and immunotherapy - the proven strongest opener for this test result.

Newly diagnosed.name: Zolbetuximab + chemotherapy (SPOTLIGHT/GLOW - the CLDN18.2 door)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized x2 (SPOTLIGHT + GLOW) - OS met in both
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: front-loaded nausea/vomiting at infusion (on-target gastric) - premedication and pacing are the craft; chemo's ledger beneath
Newly diagnosed.patient: For tumors carrying the claudin marker: an antibody that homes to it, added to chemotherapy - proven to extend life in two trials, opened by a tumor stain worth asking about by name.

Newly diagnosed.name: Nivolumab + chemotherapy (CheckMate 649 - the CPS>=5 / MSI-H door)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the CPS>=5 standard (NCCN secondhand); MSI-H IO-first framing
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized with 5-year maturity (verified) - OS met, tail verified
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: chemo's ledger plus the immune one - bought against a real 5-year tail
Newly diagnosed.patient: For spread disease with the immune marker (or the MSI-high type): chemotherapy plus immunotherapy - and at five years, one in six patients on the combination was still alive versus one in sixteen without it.

Newly diagnosed.name: Chemotherapy backbone (low-CPS, no ticket - the measured bar, with the debate said)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the low-CPS backbone (NCCN secondhand; the CPS 1-4 zone honestly contested)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized control-arm measurement (649's own arm) - the live bar; the 859-vs-649 threshold debate carried
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the fluoropyrimidine-platinum season - neuropathy and counts
Newly diagnosed.patient: When none of the four tests opens a special door: the proven chemotherapy backbone - with an honest note that experts genuinely debate whether low-marker immunotherapy adds enough, and that one hoped-for targeted drug faded on longer follow-up.

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none from therapy; the obstruction-and-intake craft is the care
Newly diagnosed.patient: Declining treatment is a real choice - with a team whose craft centers on eating, comfort, and the problems this disease specifically causes.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: T-DXd (DESTINY-Gastric04 - the 2L rewrite, entered by re-biopsy)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: the 2L HER2+ standard by head-to-head win (NCCN secondhand)
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: cytopenias, nausea - and the ILD/pneumonitis watch named out loud (any new cough is same-day news)
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: For HER2-positive disease after the first line: the guided-missile drug beat the old standard head-to-head on survival - entered through a fresh biopsy confirming the target is still there.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Ramucirumab + paclitaxel (RAINBOW - the backbone, measured live)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: phase 3 randomized (RAINBOW) + live measurement (DG-04's control arm)
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: neuropathy and counts (paclitaxel) plus the antibody's pressure-and-protein watch
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: The proven second-line combination: an antibody plus weekly chemotherapy - the standard for most, and the honest yardstick the newest drug was measured against.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Comfort-focused care
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: teaching estimate (flagged); the shelf dated to the day
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: Choosing comfort after the proven lines is a real road - and this card carries the honest shelf: one drug's approval decision lands within days, one just posted a win awaiting full review, one faded on longer follow-up.

JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
